title: Controlled perspective-reference packs
plainLanguage: A controlled reference pack shows the same body and same pose from several viewing directions. That is more useful for learning perspective than thousands of unrelated photos.
purpose: Accelerate perspective learning while keeping the mannequin videos as the project’s real-world evidence.

rules.statement: Generate small controlled packs where body shape and pose are held constant while view changes, or view is held constant while one region changes.
Mark generated references as external_reference until checked against project artwork.
Prefer region-focused reference packs (for example arm/shoulder/torso) before whole-body libraries.
Do not let reference-body proportions silently become the mannequin’s canonical proportions.

implementation.currentSupport: No controlled external reference pack is currently imported.
implementation.futureWork: Pilot a small arm–shoulder–torso pack before broader adoption.
